messages:
maria_cs: Post-call notes from PulseHaven onboarding (11:08 PT). Finance flagged a 3x embedding spend spike and asked for exportable evidence. Dropping raw asks for triage.

maria_cs: Top requests: per-route spend CSV + trend chart in Console; per-project/route embedding TTL control; pin model version per-route with soft-fallback; clearer 429 logs + remediation steps; a "first-7-days" onboarding dashboard (usage/latency/cost).

noah_product: Can you paste the route & spike time so ENG can pull traces? Also confirm TTL is server-side eviction.

maria_cs: Route: pulse-search-v1; spike: 2026-03-14T02:40:12Z. They said TTL = server-side configurable eviction (24h/7d).

alex_se: I'll attach Grafana snapshot for that window. Short workaround: add per-route tag and let billing export group by tag. Pin+fallback: backend supports pinning but Console needs a toggle.

noah_product: Proposal: two lanes — (1) Cost visibility (per-route metering + CSV + onboarding dashboard) = P0 for renewal risk; (2) Operational controls (TTL, pin UI, 429 logs) = P1/backlog. Agree @taylor_pm?

taylor_pm: Agree. Metering + CSV = P0 (ETA 2w). 7-day dashboard = ETA 3w. Operational controls investigate then backlog.

sam_bot: Created INF-4922 (per-route CSV) and INF-4923 (onboarding dashboard).

alex_se: Will attach metrics + reproducer to INF-4922 EOD. Note to ENG: check KV cache churn + overlapping batch jobs as likely cause.

maria_cs: I'll ask PulseHaven finance for a sample CSV and offer the tagging workaround. Will update here tomorrow. :thumbsup:

noah_product: CS: please provide 2-3 prioritized CSV schemas so we can scope fields (suggested: timestamp, route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_calls, est_cost_usd, request_id).

maria_cs: Will DM finance and paste examples tomorrow AM.

noah_product: Keep updates short; we'll make PRDs for items requiring cross-team design.

sam_bot: Note: thread retention = 90 days.
